statement: Single-cell profiling shows that glioblastoma cells within one tumour occupy four main cellular states, influenced by genetics and the microenvironment, and can transition between them.

context.model: primary glioblastoma tumours, single-cell RNA sequencing

measurement.assay: single-cell RNA sequencing; lineage and state analysis
measurement.effect: four interconvertible states within individual tumours

replication.note: Two independent studies, five years apart, in human tumours.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
